name: Norman Y. Mineta San José International Airport

runway.v: two parallel runways in the FAA AIP, 12L/30R and 12R/30L, each 11,000 ft x 150 ft (about 3,353 m x 46 m)

curfew.v: noise-based curfew (since October 2003): Stage II aircraft may not operate 23:00-07:00 local; quieter Stage III aircraft at or below 89.0 EPNdB and some grandfathered Stage 3 jets on the airport's Schedule of Authorized Aircraft are treated separately for 23:30-06:30; check the aircraft against the schedule; exemptions for delays beyond the operator's control, emergencies and government aircraft; fine USD 2,500 per violation
curfew.quote: FAR 36 Stage II aircraft may not operate between the hours of 11:00 p.m. and 7:00 a.m.

noise.v: curfew violations are fined USD 2,500 per occurrence by administrative citation; engine run-ups are normally not allowed during curfew hours

customs.v: CBP clears arriving aircraft 7 days a week, 09:00-18:00 (wheels down), plane-side at the FBO; permission to land must be requested at least 24 hours before arrival
customs.quote: are available 7 days per week, 0900-1800 (wheels down)

ppr.v: prior airport notification is required for all late or early arrivals (curfew hours), contact the Manager on Duty (408) 392-3500; unscheduled operations by Group V aircraft (Boeing 747) and larger need prior airport approval; all turbine engine run-ups need prior airport approval. International arrivals also need CBP permission to land (see customs)
ppr.quote: PRIOR AIRPORT NOTIFICATION IS REQUIRED FOR ALL LATE/EARLY ARRIVALS. CONTACT MANAGER ON DUTY AT (408) 392-3500.

handling.v: two FBOs: Atlantic Aviation and Signature Flight Support

hours.v: airport attended all months, all days, all hours; control tower, ground and clearance delivery 06:00-24:00 local; D-ATIS 24 hours
hours.quote: All Months, All Days, All Hours

max_aircraft.v: unscheduled operations by Group V aircraft (Boeing 747) and larger are not authorised without prior airport approval; taxiway V limited to wingspan under 118 ft (Boeing 737-900 or smaller); part of taxiway Z limited to under 135 ft (Boeing 757-300 or smaller); taxiway Y periodically limited to under 171 ft
max_aircraft.quote: UNSCHEDULED OPNS BY GROUP 5 ACFT (B747) AND LARGER NOT AUTH EXCEPT WITH PRIOR ARPT APPROVAL CTC AMGR (408) 392-3500.
